claims.text: Both fixed cells have independently checked initial evidence with partial status, one of two patterns checked and no solver/scalar completion; all registered actual CLI commands and local restore checks pass.
No SAT search/UNSAT completion, SAT causal training admission, comparative performance, full cohort result or remote publication claim.

aa.not_applicable_reason: No statistical/performance claim; no second Generate.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No additional generated cells. Required exact-source test gates include real payload corruption and sticky same-owner rejection controls. No independent CLI negative-generator arm.

positive.expected_detection: Genuine native initial_checked true on both actual twists; refusal, zero checked patterns and checked_prefix_only do not meet the positive terminal detector.

decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Not applicable; no effect-size or performance claim
decision_rule.interval: Not applicable to an exact finite software contract
decision_rule.text: PASS only if all two cells and eleven registered commands satisfy exact native, custody and source checks; every failure remains retained with no retry.
decision_rule.threshold: 2 of2 genuine initial-pattern cells plus every command and local restore assertion

inadmissible: Unresolved exact source/binary/full-library gates or draft protocol at execution.
Second Generate or replacement samples after outcomes.
Calling hidden worker directly instead of supervisor.
Promoting initial checked1/total2 partial evidence to completed solver or SAT training export.
Remote calls or new cloud spend.
invalidation_rules: Any source/binary/input/protocol mutation, wrong cell identity, failed command or interrupted worker prevents PASS.
Failures and unattempted cells remain visible; local restored bytes must match originals.

literature.claim: Actual ordinary binary n23 m3 size4 both-twist initial pattern fixture; partial outcome only.
Independent replay budget retained across repeated calls, full payload revalidation and sticky failures.
Exact full run identity and local chunked restore rules.
